objective: Prove the atom rule (role, R-a, R-b) for separated Fano atoms on every octahedral knot sphere: O1 by hand, O2 and O3 by finite computation, O4 assembly.
status: Proved 2026-11-10 (computer-assisted; pre-registered): for every octahedral knot sphere with separated Fano atoms, each atom acts as its line in exactly one class of its own handle, all acting leaves no state satisfying every line, and otherwise each acting atom holds a unit. Lemmas by hand; local check on 2,700 splices (K_2-K_7) and four neighbourhood types over K_2-K_8, none new beyond K_3.
title: The atom rule for every knot sphere
